units: <cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:7">Taan. III, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Taanit 19a:5">19ᵃ</cite>) <he>לע׳ ולא לצעקה</he> (you may blow the alarm on the Sabbath to summon people) for help, but not for prayer.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 6a:3">Kidd. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>עֶזְרָתִי מהו</he> (if one says to a woman) ‘be my help’, how is it (is she betrothed)?, v. <cite ref="P00425"><he>עֵזֶר</he></cite>.
